posts.post_subject: Did someone ever use VRP-M film
posts.content_md:
Hi!

Theese little green DPSS-lasers (in fact no diode lasers) usually have coherence lengths of about 1 cm, which is not enough for holography. Better check the coherence length with an interferometer before buying expensive holography material!

Junior
